**Needs changes before merge** (one small process fix).

**What looks good**
- `set_tool_holder` builds `SetToolBody::library` / `::spun` and runs it through `env.history.execute`, so one call is one undo step. The command's own validation does the refusing, by name.
- The tool is thin and has no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` outside tests. Exactly-one-of `library`/`points`/`clear` is enforced, and negative or non-finite numbers are refused before a command is created.
- `get_job` now shows each tool's `holder`. The new module has a provenance line and `holders.rs` is 132 lines. The skill table, the decision record, the `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #799` are all present. No dependency, build.rs, script or `.github` change.

**Local results** (PR head with current upstream/main trial-merged, no code conflicts, separate target dir)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_holder` | 5 passed |
| `--test mcp` / `mcp_live` / `mcp_model` / `mcp_setup` / `mcp_verify` | 13 / 10 / 5 / 6 / 3 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
1. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is 15, but upstream/main is already 15 (from 52457c32, "a contributor's claim must be live"). So after the merge this PR's change to `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` carries no bump of its own; the net diff against main leaves the file untouched. The PR body also says it bumps to 15. AGENTS.md ("Two process PRs open at once both bump to the same number; whichever merges second takes the next number") means this one should take **16**. Please set the file to `16` (`git merge upstream/main` first if main has moved again).

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs` is 271 lines, so it is under the limit.
- Only the camcraft-mcp skill is touched among the process files; nothing else in the diff conflicts with AGENTS.md. The 15 to 16 bump needs a #681 comment when it merges.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: f81afa884c956eaac367b0ed9317e0c11e218f87 -->
**Independent review** (a second reviewer, separate from the author's own checks): **Ready for the maintainer to merge, after one required process step (below).**

**What looks good**
- `set_tool_holder` (`crates/app/src/mcp/holders.rs`) builds the GUI tool editor's own `SetToolBody::library` / `::spun` command and runs it through `env.history.execute`: no direct world writes, one undo step per call, all validation at command creation (`.map_err(|e| e.to_string())`), so a refusal never reaches history. Exactly one of `library` / `points` / `clear` is enforced; negative, non-finite, wrong-typed or empty inputs are refused by name before the command is built.
- A holder set this way is an explicit pick: library and spun bodies are constructed with `machine_default: false` (`tool_body.rs:130`), the same as the tool editor's pick, so the collision laws judge the real shape and not the machine-default stand-in. `clear` goes back to the plain cylinder exactly as the GUI's clear does; the shank-fit refusal ("a shank the holder cannot take") comes from the library command, so a Weldon holder on the wrong shank is refused. Mount fit beyond that is not a check the GUI command makes either, so nothing diverges.
- `list_holder_library` is read-only (reads `holder_library::library()`, no env access). `get_job` now shows each tool's holder, so an agent can see the result.
- Tests in `crates/app/tests/mcp_holder.rs` cover library set, undo/redo to the previous holder, drawn profile and clear, the full list, and 13 refusals that leave the history untouched; decision file present. No unwrap/expect/panic outside tests.

**Local results (merged with main a6bd69d8; clean merge)**
- `mcp_holder` 5/5, `mcp` 13/13, `mcp_live` 10/10, `commands_undo` 30/30, `project_roundtrip` 71/71, `holder_library` 11/11, `machine_default_holder` 13/13, `tool_body` 12/12, `tool_body_judged` 8/8, `tool_body_view` 7/7: all pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Required step before merge (process, not a code defect)**
1. The PR edits `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`, a process file, but `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is still 16 (main is 16). Merge `origin/main` and bump it to the next free number (17), then the merging session posts the usual #681 note. GitHub reports the PR as MERGEABLE, so this is a small follow-up commit.

**Notes (non-blocking)**
- A stale-caches check is not in the tool itself: re-verification after a holder change relies on the existing `SetToolBody` path, which the GUI shares; `tool_body_judged` passes on the merged tree.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
